title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Schedule of Balance, Hold, Discharge and Transfer Terms
content:
This schedule sets the account terms of each Specialty Pharmacy Program tier: the specialty credit limit, when a fill's cost share is due, how long an enrollment may stay on hold, whether a hospitalization or therapy-pause hold is available, how soon discharge letters go out, and where a prescription may be transferred.

## Balance and holds

| Tier | Specialty credit limit (balance due above which further shipments wait for payment) | Cost share due (calendar days after shipment) | Maximum hold (calendar days from the hold start date) | Hold for hospitalization or therapy pause available |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | $250.00 | 30 | 60 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | $250.00 | 30 | 60 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | $300.00 | 30 | 60 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | $300.00 | 30 | 90 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | $500.00 | 30 | 90 | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | $500.00 | 30 | 120 | Yes |

The maximum hold is the number of calendar days an enrollment may stay on hold before it is discharged, with the hold start date as day zero. A hospitalization or therapy-pause hold is placed at the member's or the prescriber's request.

## Discharge and transfer-out

| Tier | Member and prescriber notified of discharge within (business days after discharge) | Pharmacies a covered specialty prescription may be transferred to | Transfer-out processing (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | 5 | any pharmacy | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | 5 | any pharmacy | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | 5 | network specialty pharmacies only | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | 3 | network specialty pharmacies only | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | 3 | network specialty pharmacies only | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | 3 | network specialty pharmacies only | 2 |

The transfer column names the pharmacies to which an active specialty prescription may be transferred at the member's request while the prescription is still covered.

## Figures compared

- Credit limits rise from $250.00 on Northbridge Specialty Open Access and Northbridge Specialty Preferred, to $300.00 on the two Exclusive tiers, to $500.00 on Northbridge Specialty Care Management and Northbridge Specialty Total Care.
- *Illustration (assumed date):* a hold that starts on June 10 reaches day 60 on August 9 and day 90 on September 8.
